title: Holiday paragraph frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: At the airport; at the seaport; my summer holiday
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 12 (Pupil PDF worksheet: holiday paragraph frame)
intro: Lesson 12: Writing sentences about a holiday. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Linking words
points: فِي اليَوْمِ الأَوَّلِ: on the first day

arabic.text:
فِي عُطْلَةِ الصَّيْفِ سَافَرْتُ إِلَى تُرْكِيَا بِالطَّائِرَةِ.
زُرْتُ مَسْجِدًا كَبِيرًا، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى البَحْرِ وَسَبَحْتُ.
كَانَ الجَوُّ حَارًّا.
كُنْتُ سَعِيدًا جِدًّا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ.

parts.label: Teacher
parts.text: keep both sentences, put ثُمَّ between them, drop the first full stop.

frame.label: Link
starters: This links to the question because

questions.q: Join two sentences with ثُمَّ: زُرْتُ جَدِّي. ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ.
questions.a: زُرْتُ جَدِّي، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ.

questions.q: Write your holiday paragraph on the pupil PDF (or the portal response box): five sentences with where, how, what you did, weather, feeling; use وَ and ثُمَّ.
questions.a: A five-sentence paragraph following the model

questions.q: Extend: swap paragraphs with a partner and find one thing to improve.
Think again: what makes a holiday story interesting?
questions.a: Details in order: where, how, what, weather, feeling.
